## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a regression test for a bug or false positive)
- [ ] `check` still executes no repository code, and the `verify` profile is not weakened
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] Report schema, finding codes, and exit codes are unchanged, or the change is called out below
- [ ] `docs/FINDINGS.md`, README, or `docs/` updated if output or behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
